newsitem.title: UK: Dated Brent extends gains, trades March +48 cents.
newsitem.headline: Dated Brent extends gains, trades March +48 cents.

text.p: North Sea benchmark Dated Brent extended early gains to trade around 20 cents up from Tuesday at March Brent +48 cents for a Feb 10-12 loader, traders said.
Earlier, short covering by one Scandinavian refiner saw Dated trade at the stronger level of Feb Brent +2 cents a barrel, up around 12 cents from the previous trade on Tuesday.
Traders said the persistent strength reflected the tight supply situation well into early February.
The cargoes were two of the three cargoes due down the paper chains on Friday.
